sentence: This project plans a research framework for improving energy efficiency in housing by studying homes, insulation and household energy use.
This project tries to protect privacy when many machines learn together, using randomization in how they share information.
This project builds cleanroom training with industry partners to prepare technicians for micro/nanotechnology and semiconductor work.
This project builds a set of tools that turn on genes only in certain cell types of wood-forming tissue in poplar trees.
This project builds a virtual replica of skeletal muscle to predict how muscle adapts to different levels of activity and stress.
This project studies the genomes of Amoebozoa, single cell microscopic eukaryotes, to find out how their amoeboid body plan evolved.
This project tries to find out whether ocean invertebrates called ctenophores control how their neurons make proteins from mRNA.
This project studies the genes behind the change from gilled mushrooms to puffball-like mushrooms in a fungus called Lentinus tigrinus.
This project grows thin films of yttrium iron garnet with erbium to test efficient conversion of microwaves to optical photons.
This project tries to trap electron-positron plasmas in small cavities inside a solid such as diamond and work out their temperature and density.
This project studies how large language models use and store knowledge, and builds ways to correct and update that knowledge.
This project builds cybersecurity modules with hands-on exercises where applications are built, broken by finding vulnerabilities, and then fixed.
This project builds autonomous robots and sensors that use AI to monitor highways, railways and bridges and predict when they need maintenance.
This project builds a way to find hidden defects inside electronic packages using millimeter-wave imaging and artificial intelligence.
This project studies how bacteria sense small molecules with receptors, and builds machine learning models to design proteins.
This project studies how cells generate and coordinate the physical forces they need to move through tight spaces.
This project tests a training method that uses cognitive models to help employees remember and report phishing threats.
This project tries to change how much gene activity varies from cell to cell and tests how that affects the inflammatory response.
This project builds an open-source community around a Python library that compiles quantum programs so they run on different hardware.
